title: Greenhouse Gear Garden Story Evidence Card
evidenceSkill: Build a fictional story claim by naming a first clue, second clue, because line, evidence sentence, and bookend note.
useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only evidence card for one invented greenhouse gear garden story: ____________________.
adultSetup: Adult: set out a blank evidence card, pencil, and pretend gear garden sketch; keep every clue invented on paper: ____________________.
kidDirection: Writer: invent a greenhouse keeper who notices paper gears, glass-pane shadows, and a small garden mystery inside the story: ____________________.
storyClaimPrompt: Story claim: what small idea about the greenhouse keeper can your two clue details support inside the story? ____________________.
firstCluePrompt: First clue: choose one gear squeak, window glint, or seedling tag that supports the story claim: ____________________.
secondCluePrompt: Second clue: choose a different greenhouse detail that points to the same story claim: ____________________.
becauseLinePrompt: Because line: connect both clue details to the story claim in one clear reason: ____________________.
evidenceSentencePrompt: Evidence sentence: write one sentence using the story claim, first clue, second clue, and because line: ____________________.
bookendNotePrompt: Bookend note: write a short final note that reminds the writer how the two clues hold up the story claim: ____________________.
quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult points to two pretend greenhouse details, and the writer fills only the because line blank: ____________________.
takeHomeLine: Take-home line: keep this greenhouse evidence card for one later adult-led offline paper story pass: ____________________.

becauseLinePrompt: Because line: explain why the first clue and second clue both point toward the story claim: ____________________.
evidenceSentencePrompt: Evidence sentence: combine the story claim with both clues and the because line in one sentence: ____________________.

quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult reads the story claim, and the writer chooses only a first clue and second clue: ____________________.
